safety: Side-effecting (creates a Linear ticket). Eval runs must STOP at the drafted ticket — do NOT call linctl issue create / save_issue. Subagent instructions enforce draft-only.

evals.prompt: let's create a follow-up ticket for the out-of-scope error-handling cleanup baz flagged on PR <PR_NUMBER> — put it in the FRG templates project and include the PR link and the file refs
evals.expected_output: Resolves team FRG + the Templates-in-DYS project, drafts a ticket (Context/Problem/Evidence/Suggested approach/Source) with the PR link and code refs, absolute dates, and STOPS to show the draft for approval. Does not create it.

evals.prompt: this baz comment says 'filed for later' but doesn't say where — is there actually a follow-up ticket for it? if not, draft one
evals.expected_output: First searches Linear / the PR thread for an existing ticket and reports whether one exists; only if none, drafts a new follow-up ticket and shows it for approval. Avoids duplicates.
